label: email
note: Standard email validation covering local, domain, and TLD per RFC 5322 simplified

label: url
note: Validates HTTP/HTTPS URLs with optional scheme and www prefix

label: phone-e164
note: E.164 international phone format: optional plus, 1-15 digits, no leading zero

label: phone-us
note: US phone number with optional area code parentheses and flexible separators

label: credit-card
note: Validates Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, and JCB card numbers by prefix and length

label: ipv4
note: IPv4 address where each octet is 0-255

label: uuid
note: Standard UUID v1-v5 format in lowercase hex with hyphens

label: slug
note: URL-safe slug: lowercase alphanumerics separated by single hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphen

label: date-dd-mm-yyyy
note: Day-month-year date with separators, month 01-12, day 01-31, year 1900-2099

label: password
note: Password requiring at least one lowercase, one uppercase, one digit, one special char, min 8 chars

label: isbn-13
note: ISBN-13 with prefix 978/979, 10 digits, and check digit 0-9 or X

label: postal-us
note: US ZIP code (5 digits) or ZIP+4 (5-4 digits with hyphen)

label: ssn
note: US SSN excluding invalid area/group/serial numbers like 000, 666, 9xx, 00 group, 0000 serial

label: mac-address
note: MAC address in colon-separated hex pairs (6 groups of 2)

label: ipv6-full
note: Full IPv6 address with 8 groups of 1-4 hex digits separated by colons

label: jwt
note: JSON Web Token structure: three base64url segments separated by dots

label: semver
note: Semantic versioning: major.minor.patch with optional prerelease and build metadata

label: hex-color
note: CSS hex color code: 3 or 6 hex digits prefixed with #

label: base64
note: Base64 encoded string with optional padding of 0-2 equals signs

label: hostname
note: DNS hostname: labels of 1-63 chars, total up to 253, TLD 2-63 letters

label: api-endpoint
note: REST API endpoint path starting with /api/v<version> followed by lowercase path segments

label: api-key
note: API key: 16-64 alphanumeric characters, no special chars or spaces

label: tax-id-in
note: Indian PAN/Tax ID format: 2 digits, hyphen, 7 digits

label: bank-account
note: 16-digit bank account number with optional spaces every 4 digits

label: routing-number
note: US ABA routing number: optional 2-letter prefix, 5-12 digits

label: credit-card-strict
note: Strict credit card validation by brand prefix and exact length, no spaces or dashes allowed

label: domain-label
note: Single domain label or full domain: lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, max 63 chars per label

label: iso8601-datetime
note: ISO 8601 datetime with optional fractional seconds and timezone offset or Z

label: postcode-uk
note: UK postcode: 2-3 letter outward code, space, 1-5 digit inward code

label: postal-canada
note: Canadian postal code: 5 digits, hyphen, 4 digits
